citation: Abrogueña, J. B. R., Bagarinao, T. U., & Chícharo, L. (2012). Fish habitats in a small, human-impacted Sibunag mangrove creek (Guimaras, Philippines): a basis for mangrove resource enhancement. Ecohydrology & Hydrobiology, 12(4), 311–319. https://doi.org/10.2478/v10104-012-0025-z

accessReview.alternateIndexedPdf: Search-indexed content identifies the article and repeats its abstract; direct page retrieval failed, so the full article, methods, tables, and rights statement were not verified.

evidenceScope.habitatContext: Mangrove creek influenced by nearby aquaculture; the source abstract compares conditions from outside to inner creek.
evidenceScope.sourceReportedSample: 475 fish, total weight 3,875 g, and 50 identified species in 32 families; 32 species had fewer than five individuals.
evidenceScope.evidenceType: Historical primary fish-assemblage study summarized by its official SEAFDEC repository record; not an accessible occurrence-event dataset in this review.

decision.use: Source acquisition lead; prioritize full-text/table and reuse-rights verification
decision.reason: The named Guimaras study and aggregate sample summary are verified, but the article's taxon table, sampling dates, coordinates, license, and per-habitat taxon crosswalk were not retrievable from reviewed official records.

nextActions: Locate an authorized full text or publisher record and confirm applicable reuse terms before extracting the list.
If access is obtained, review methods, sampling dates, site description, species table, and habitat-by-taxon evidence separately.
Keep the creek habitat context distinct from inland freshwater rivers and from marine records; do not infer salinity or a mapped boundary without source evidence.
Do not interpret the article's approximate commercial-species count as present-day catchability, legal status, fishing permission, safety or local rules.
limitations: The phrase open access in the abstract describes the creek, not an article reuse license.
The 2012 publication year is not a verified field-sampling date.
No species, habitat-specific distribution, geometry, current presence, or public app row is asserted by this review.
